reference_definition.const: Compare transition energies/oscillator strengths and matched guest transition densities at identical guest coordinates for full-host, deleted-host and deleted-partner controls. Bright/dark splitting is E(bright)-E(dark) with both state identities recorded; host deletion measures combined host response, not purely electrostatics.
